text: The small gallery has a pale green door. A wooden shelf stands beside a window. On the shelf are a ceramic bowl, a folded linen cloth, and a glass vase. A visitor walks through the courtyard and notices the gentle shade of the trees. The rooms are quiet during the afternoon. A painted landscape hangs above a plain bench.
